profile.name: Andrii Shafar
profile.headline: Software Engineer & Applied Researcher
profile.summary: Product-minded software engineer with six years of evidence-backed work spanning fundraising technology, realtime AI interviewing, mental-health research platforms, cloud infrastructure, developer tooling, and applied research. Comfortable moving from public interfaces and payment flows to backend services, data pipelines, multi-tenant authorization, and delivery systems.

audit.summary: This professional history was reconstructed from 8,539 authored, non-merge commit objects across 20 local repositories. Merge commits and a different contributor with a similar name were excluded.

metrics.label: authored commits reviewed for this resume

experience.summary: Six years of full-stack product work across nine services and applications, from donor-facing campaign and checkout flows to backend services, operations tooling, integrations, and AI-assisted workflows.
highlights: Built and evolved a component-driven fundraising platform across Nuxt generations and a skin-based Vue 3 checkout with reusable multi-step flows, attribution, localization, and build-time gateway composition.
Integrated and hardened Stripe wallets and 3DS, PayPal, PayArc, Cardknox card and ACH, raffle preauthorization, and configurable international tax-compliance and receipt workflows.
Delivered campaign, team, and donation operations with contact management, secure analytics, custom reports, streaming exports, and queued campaign-total aggregation.
Built email and SMS outreach with reusable audiences, templates, drafts, asynchronous delivery, provider callbacks, audience safeguards, and operational health diagnostics.
Implemented peer matching, team nominations, auctions, raffle registration, prize wheels, projector and live-feed experiences, with server-side eligibility and inventory protections.
Designed OAuth-protected AI and MCP integrations plus HubSpot CRM automation with typed tools, approval-gated actions, setup reconciliation, entity linking, and guarded bulk operations.

experience.summary: Backend, frontend, and developer-platform work for realtime voice interviewing, durable background processing, speech-to-text, production operations, and reusable AI engineering workflows.
highlights: Designed an owner-scoped background-job platform with durable state and event delivery, registry-based dispatch, frontend integration, admission control, and cross-user authorization safeguards.
Built configurable realtime and batch speech-to-text pipelines and improved voice interviews with echo suppression, resilient WebSocket reconnects, and buffered-audio recovery.
Refactored realtime interview and voice-test sessions onto shared event, action, runtime-state, and ordered-shutdown primitives to reduce coupling across workflows.
Delivered full-stack automated interview testing with generated speech, PCM injection, lifecycle controls, local and cloud recording storage, and diagnostic exports.
Modernized the Python platform around uv, Ruff, basedpyright, Alembic, and honest CI gates; added structured crash visibility and hardened authorization and validation boundaries.
Created a reusable AI-engineering toolkit with orchestration and review workflows, automated installation, typed Python APIs, and Claude Code and Codex plugin packaging.

experience.scope: Research platforms, reporting, and cloud delivery
experience.summary: Cross-stack engineering for survey research, mental-health scoring, multi-tenant reporting, machine-to-machine exports, guided workforce journeys, and AWS delivery infrastructure.
highlights: Re-architected a Python reporting application into a typed uv monorepo with a separated API, generated client, modern React frontend, migration-managed PostgreSQL and RBAC, and containerized delivery.
Designed and hardened AWS CDK infrastructure using managed containers and PostgreSQL, HTTPS edge delivery, keyless CI authentication, conditional rollouts, and workload-aware cost controls.
Built secure multi-tenant identity and administration spanning sessions, password recovery, organizations, teams, invitations, self-service workspace creation, and revision-level authorization.
Implemented role-scoped reporting and external survey synchronization with encrypted organization credentials, operational sync monitoring, curated trends, and live TeamQ and OrgQ journeys.

Expanded the MHQ survey and research platform with lifecycle controls, accurate drop-off analytics, mobile interaction safeguards, an embeddable Web Component, and an invite-only CSV Research Calculator.

Delivered machine-to-machine survey exports and a service-account console with scoped access, one-time credentials, token rotation, stable historical revision identity, deterministic CSV contracts, and pagination.
